svg.title: REWARD: A Living Forest
svg.desc: Clean vector reconstruction of the supplied British Columbia Forest Service campfire poster. Manually authored Bézier artwork and custom headline lettering; supporting sans-serif lettering has been fitted and outlined. Not an original agency master. No raster image, automatic contour trace, or scan texture is included.
